arguments.message: Quinn planning proposal: to avoid self-overlap and maximize soft overlaps, I suggest a single continuous attendance chain on the densest meetings: m013 Gaming [1,5), then m007 Music [5,7), m009 Gaming [7,9), m010 Music [9,11), m001 Music [11,15). This gives overlap opportunities with many participants and no conflicts. I plan to skip the other overlapping meetings unless there is strong group preference for a different canonical meeting in any time block. If others can align to these same intervals/windows where applicable, that seems high-value.

Riley planning: I support using one canonical meeting per overlapping block to avoid self-overlap. For my meetings, a good no-conflict chain seems: m013 Gaming [1,5), then m007 Music [5,7) (within window [4,7)), then m009 Gaming [7,9), then late block either m008 Gaming [11,14) or m001 Music [11,15), but not both. Since m001 has 6 participants vs m008 has 5, I currently prefer m001 [11,15) for maximum overlap potential. That would mean skipping m003/m014/m005/m016/m002/m011 and likely m008. If others agree, aligning on m013, m007, m009, m001 seems strong.

Jordan planning: I agree with the single canonical chain approach to avoid self-overlap. For my meetings, the high-density no-conflict path looks like m013 Gaming [1,5), then m007 Music [5,7) (inside [4,7)), then m009 Gaming [7,9), then m010 Music [9,11) (inside [8,11)), then m001 Music [11,15). This dominates alternatives because each block has many participants and avoids overlap penalties. I currently propose skipping m015/m014/m005/m016/m002/m004/m011/m006/m012 and also m008 unless group strongly prefers the 11-14 gaming instead of 11-15 music. If others can align on these exact intervals, we should get broad pairwise overlap.

Avery planning: I support the same no-conflict canonical chain for maximizing soft overlap: m013 [1,5), then m007 [5,7) within its [4,7) window, then m009 [7,9), then m010 [9,11) within [8,11), then m001 [11,15). This avoids overlap penalties and aligns with Quinn/Jordan; Riley can also align except m010 if unavailable. For my other meetings (m015/m003/m014/m005/m002/m004/m011/m006/m008), I currently propose skip unless the group identifies a better canonical choice in a time block. (phase=planning, iter=1)
